metadata.purpose: W0.1 repro-case: a declared companion page (Input/pages.json, the AppGen-authoring convention Build-NpdevApp.ps1 flattens into a workspace-menu seed) backed by web/companion.html + web/theme.css, proving the extension-inventory's handwrittenScreen category is non-zero for a real fixture -- the escape hatch that previously reported zero unconditionally. pages.json itself is inert to `npdev generate` (BusinessUiEmitter's own doc: neither pages.json nor web/ ever reaches the generator's model layer) -- it ships here only so the fixture matches the real AppGen shape this category protects against; what the generator/checker actually see is --webAssetsRoot, auto-detected by generate-sample-app.ps1 from this sample's Input/web/.
